fixture_description: Hand-authored synthetic desktop-memory relevance fixture. Fictional names/commitments. Not a natural-user corpus or vendor comparison. No-evidence queries measure candidate false positives, not generative abstention.
latency_quantiles: median averages the center pair; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n); max includes every sample
